description: This Java class 'WorldPayEvents' handles integration with the WorldPay payment gateway, including request initiation and notification handling for payment processing within an Ofbiz-based e-commerce system. It manages generating payment requests, processing gateway callbacks, updating order/payment statuses, and communicating results via email.

classes.name: WorldPayEvents
classes.description: Main class handling WorldPay payment gateway interactions, including request creation and callback processing.

methods.name: worldPayRequest
methods.description: Handles creating a payment request to WorldPay, preparing parameters such as order details, customer address, and configuration, then redirects the user to WorldPay for payment.

methods.name: worldPayNotify
methods.description: Processes asynchronous notifications from WorldPay about payment status, updating order and payment preferences accordingly, and sending confirmation emails.

methods.name: setPaymentPreferences
methods.description: Updates the payment preferences for a given order based on gateway response.

methods.name: setPaymentPreference
methods.description: Updates individual payment preference with transaction details, stores response info, and creates a payment record.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the WorldPay payment gateway, either from the database or property files.
